segments.an4.37:1.1: “Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo parihānāya nibbānasseva santike.
segments.an4.37:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti, indriyesu guttadvāro hoti, bhojane mattaññū hoti, jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti.
segments.an4.37:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
segments.an4.37:2.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti.
segments.an4.37:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
segments.an4.37:3.3: Yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati; rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ; cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
segments.an4.37:3.4: Sotena saddaṃ sutvā … ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā … jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā … kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā … manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
segments.an4.37:3.9: Yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati; rakkhati manindriyaṃ; manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
segments.an4.37:3.10: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti.
segments.an4.37:4.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti –
segments.an4.37:4.3: ‘neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya; yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya. Iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi, navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati, anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cā’ti.
segments.an4.37:4.4: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu bhojane mattaññū hoti.
segments.an4.37:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti;
segments.an4.37:5.3: rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti;
segments.an4.37:5.4: rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeti, pāde pādaṃ accādhāya, sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasi karitvā;
segments.an4.37:5.5: rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paccuṭṭhāya caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti.
segments.an4.37:5.6: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti.
segments.an4.37:5.7: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo parihānāya, nibbānasseva santiketi.
segments.an4.37:8.1: “Appamādarato bhikkhu, pamāde bhayadassi vā [bhayadassāvī (ka.) dha. pa.32 dhammapadepi];

lines: Sattame nibbānasantikeyeva caratīti kilesanibbānassa anupādāparinibbānassa ca santikeyeva carati “na cirasseva adhigamissatī”ti katvā.
Gāthāya appamādaratoti samathavipassanāya appamajjane rato abhirato, appamādeneva rattindivaṃ vītināmentoti attho.
Pamādaṃ bhayato passantoti nirayūpapattiādibhayahetuto pamādaṃ bhayato passanto.
Abhabbo parihānāyāti so evarūpo samathavipassanādhammehi maggaphalehi vā parihānāya abhabbo.
Samathavipassanāto hi sampattato na parihāyati, itarāni ca appattāni pāpuṇātīti.
